_about: GF cinematic-engine script VM (Ifrit/Leviathan/Bahamut/Cerberus/Alexander/Brothers/Eden). Decoded from FF8_EN.exe (Ifrit module VmOpcodeTable 0x1874F10; all 7 GFs share the numbering). length = python expr over op (opcode word) and w (following words, signed); refs: word index of a relative offset (base = opcode word unless base=word0), kind code/spawn/particle/data.

0x000.name: EndChannel
0x000.semantics: If channel!=0: StreamCursor=0 (channel pointer stored as 0 = channel unused), wait 0x8000. If channel 0: KILL BONE: clear the 3 chanStreamPtr + chanWait, free its node-matrix slot (B651E0/B65270; key table 0x2797204 entry = bone id cleared), --sceneHeader+0x18 (live bone count), rt->boneCursor-- (order list shifted), wait=chanWaitSpeed.
0x000.notes: Existing IDA name GF_Ifrit_AnimVM_Op0_FrameYield kept (misleading: it is end-channel / kill-bone).

0x001.name: LoopSequenceOrFinish
0x001.semantics: If ctx+0xD0 (loop count) < ctx+0xD1 (loop max): ++count, GF_Ifrit_InitBones(), cursor = opcode+param0, boneCursor=0 (whole summon restarts). Else: bone order list filled with 0xFF, SequenceState+8=0, all channels cleared, wait=-1, sceneHeader+0x18=0, sceneHeader+0x1A=4 (sequence finished).
0x001.notes: Existing name GF_Ifrit_AnimVM_Op1_SubSeqLoop kept. Used once, at the end of the root program.

0x002.name: Jump
0x002.semantics: StreamCursor += param0 (byte offset relative to the opcode word).

0x003.name: Call
0x003.semantics: Per-channel return stack: bone[+0x24 + 8*chan + 4*depth] = &param1 (= opcode+4), depth byte bone+0x44+chan ++ (2 levels per channel); cursor = opcode + param0.

0x004.name: Return
0x004.semantics: --depth byte bone+0x44+chan; cursor = saved return address from bone+0x24+8*chan+4*depth.

0x005.name: FlagOp
0x005.high_bits: op>>12 = sub-op: 0 (and 6..15) flags|=mask; 1 flags&=~mask; 2 if (flags&mask)!=0 jump opcode+param1 else fall through; 3 if (flags&mask)==0 jump; 4 wait (retry same instr next tick) while (flags&mask)!=0; 5 wait until (flags&mask)!=0. Bits 9..11 unused.
0x005.semantics: Operates on the shared 16-bit sequence flag word *(rt+0x10)+2 (inter-bone synchronisation flags). Sub-ops 4/5 yield wait=chanWaitSpeed and leave the cursor on the instruction.
0x005.notes: Verified in the root program (e.g. 5005 1000 = wait until flag 0x1000).

0x006.name: LoadFile
0x006.high_bits: bit15 clear: slot=op>>9 (0..63); param0 = source: lo byte 0xFF -> dest ctx+0xB8; lo<0x80 -> dest=Magic_b_00[lo] (+ sub-table offset via dword_1874894/dword_18748B0 indexed by hi byte unless hi==0xFF); lo&0x80 -> dest=Magic_b_00[lo&0x7F]+(hi<<12). bit15 set: slot=(op>>9)&0x3F, dest=ctx+0xB8; if slot&0x20 the file id = (slot&0x1F)+363 and Magic_b_00 is not updated.
0x006.semantics: Starts an async battle-file load (pre_LoadBattleFile, callback B2BB40) of file ctx->frameLimit+ctx[0xA2]+slot into dest, records Magic_b_00[ctx[0xA2]+slot]=dest, ctx+0xB4=dest, sets busy flag byte_2798219. If a load is already busy: wait chanWaitSpeed and retry the same instruction.
0x006.notes: Old IDA name au_re_BattleFile_preLoad_55 was wrong. Length: cursor=&param0 when (s16)op<=0 i.e. bit15 set, else &param1. Seen: 8406 (len 2), 0c06 0501 (len 4).

0x007.name: SetFreezeOthers
0x007.semantics: Freeze/unfreeze other bones; marks current bone 0x80 in the bone order list (keeps running).

0x008.name: WaitLoadDone
0x008.semantics: If a file load is busy (byte_2798219) or not completed (byte_2798218==0): wait chanWaitSpeed and retry; else advance.

0x009.name: Wait
0x009.semantics: vmWaitRequest = (op>>9)<<7 (128 = one tick at the default chanWaitSpeed).

0x01A.name: SetBoneHandler

operands.name: hi byte = boneHandlerId, lo nibble = N extra words

0x01A.semantics: bone->handlerId(+0x18) = param0>>8; bone+0xA0 = pointer to param1 (inline handler parameter block of N words, read later by the bone handler).

0x01B.name: Nop4
0x01B.semantics: No effect, skips one operand word.

0x01C.name: PokeBoneField
0x01C.high_bits: op>>9 == 1 -> write s16, otherwise write u8
0x01C.semantics: *(bone + param0) = param1 (byte or word). Raw field poke on the current bone.

0x01D.name: WaitBoneGoneThenEnd
0x01D.semantics: Resolve bone ref param0 (GfCinematic_GetRotationVector @0xB65370 = find bone by id in the order list; 0xFFF0+ = relative refs via self/parent ids at +0x14/+0x16, bit14 = id relative to bone[0x1B]). While it exists: wait 128 (1 tick) and retry. When not found (returns bones[0]): executes op 0x00 (end channel / kill bone).
0x01D.notes: Cursor never advances; length 4 is nominal (param0 read at +2). B65370 is misnamed in IDA (it is FindBoneByRef).

0x01E.name: SetLoopCounter
0x01E.semantics: bone byte[+0x20 + (op>>14)] = param0 (loop counter for op 0x1F).

0x01F.name: LoopDecJump
0x01F.semantics: --bone[+0x20+(op>>14)]; if nonzero cursor = opcode+param0 (backward loop) else fall through.

0x020.name: SetFadeLayers
0x020.semantics: RGB = clamp(outPosX/Y/Z,0..255) packed (B66A90); intensity = clamp(16*outAngleX,0..4096); writes intensity+colour into the 4 entries of stru_1D9898C (global colour/fade layers, 44 bytes each; op 0x6D toggles their bit1).

0x021.name: SetDataPointer
0x021.high_bits: bit15: base = Magic_b_01+*(Magic_b_01+0x1C) else MAGIC_TEXTURE_BUFFER_PTR. sub=(op>>12)&7: 1 -> ctx+0xB8 = base+offset; 2 -> ctx+0x212 = base+offset, half=(size<<8)/2 stored, ctx+0x216 = ptr + half*pingPong (double buffer); other -> ctx+0x74 and ctx+0x70 = base+offset (bump arena base/cursor).
0x021.semantics: Sets engine work-buffer pointers inside the magic texture buffer.

0x022.name: ApplyActionResult
0x022.semantics: Applies the GF action result (ctx+0xCC -> action: target array +8, count +16): all targets (ApplyActionResultToTargets) or only the target whose TargetSlotId == bone+0x1B (ApplyActionResultToTarget).

0x023.name: SetBlendMode
0x023.semantics: <=3: bone+0xCC |= 0x02000000 (semi-trans), bone+0x92 bits5-6 = abr; >3: clear semi-trans bit, bits5-6 = 1.

0x024.name: SetOptionBits
0x024.high_bits: v=op>>9: if (v&3)!=0 bone+0xDE = v else bone+0xDE |= v
0x024.semantics: Sets the bone's draw option byte +0xDE (OT bias / blending variants).

0x025.name: SetSpriteOriented
0x025.semantics: Same as op 0x36 (sprite setup, draw handler 5) then orientation byte bone+0x1E = 9.

0x026.name: StartChannel
0x026.semantics: bone->chanStreamPtr[ch] = opcode + param1, chanWait[ch]=0, return-stack depth[ch]=0 (B2D8A0). Starts a parallel script on the SAME bone. If param0==0 and channels 1,2 are busy the scan reaches index 3 (overflows into chanWait); if that is nonzero too the instruction is skipped.
0x026.notes: Offset relative to the opcode word.

0x027.name: UploadAltTexAndImage
0x027.semantics: If a file load is busy: wait+retry. Else upload alternative texture param0 (isGF_Ifrit_AltTextureLoader @B2E700: Magic_ReadAlternativeTexture + GF_AlternativeTexture_UNK), then rewinds 4 and uploads image param0 from the loaded-file table (B2E750, as op 0x28). Each step waits chanWaitSpeed and retries the whole instruction if the VRAM queue is full.

0x028.name: UploadImage
0x028.semantics: Thunk to B2E750: if load busy wait; else B66560(param0) resolves image data (ctx+0xA8 index -> Magic_b_00 file) + RECT (ctx+0x9C table) and queues the VRAM upload; queue full -> wait+retry, success -> advance 4.

0x029.name: VramUpload
0x029.length: 4 if (op & 0x8000) else (8 if (op & 0x4000) else (10 if (op & 0x2000) else 4))
0x029.high_bits: bit15: rect=ctx+0x98 table[param0] (8-byte RECTs), data=ctx+0xB4 (last loaded file) len 4; else bit14: rect=table[param0], data=Magic_b_00[param1&0x7F]+(param2<<12) len 8; else bit13: inline RECT {x,y,w,h}=param0..3, data=ctx+0xB4 len 10; else: alt-texture upload of param0 (as op 0x27 first half) len 4.
0x029.semantics: Queues Battle_QueueVramUpload_Type0_RectData. Waits+retries while a file load is busy.

0x02A.name: StopChannels
0x02A.semantics: bone->chanStreamPtr[ch]=0 (kills parallel channel scripts on the current bone).

0x02B.name: PlaySE
0x02B.high_bits: op>>9 = sound index in the table at ctx+0xC4

0x02C.name: StopSoundChannels
0x02C.high_bits: (op>>9)&0xF = channel mask (bit n -> sound channel n+1)
0x02C.semantics: sub_46B450(0, mask): stops the masked sound channels.

0x02E.name: SetBoneIdShort
0x02E.semantics: bone id (+0x12) = the NEXT stream word (param0), but the cursor only advances 2, so that word is then executed as an opcode.
0x02E.notes: Looks like a bug/variant of 0x33 (same write, len 4). Not reached in the Ifrit script.

0x031.name: TransSummonStream
0x031.semantics: If file load busy wait+retry; else BdTransSummonStream(B25DB0(slot), &ctx+0xA3 ready flag). Pair with 0x34.

0x032.name: SpawnBone
0x032.semantics: If the bone order list has room (list[sceneHeader+0x38 - 1]==0xFF): take the first free bone slot (chanStreamPtr[0]==0), append it to the order list, its chan0 = opcode+param0, ++sceneHeader+0x18, init (B65160), copy accumRot/accumPos, handlerId, renderListOffset, +0x1B target slot and +0xB0..0xB7 from the current bone; new+0x14 = parent id, new+0x16 = parent+0x14, new id = sceneHeader[0]++; run its bone handler; workspace+0xFC = new bone. Else skip.
0x032.notes: Most common opcode in the Ifrit script (97 reached hits). Program offset relative to the opcode word; new bone runs in the same tick if later in the order list.

0x033.name: SetBoneId
0x033.semantics: bone id (+0x12) = param0 (key for node matrices and bone refs).

0x034.name: WaitStreamReady
0x034.semantics: If ctx+0xA3 (summon-stream ready flag set by 0x31) == 0: wait chanWaitSpeed and retry; else advance.

0x035.name: NullNoAdvance
0x035.semantics: nullsub: does not advance the cursor nor set a wait -> infinite loop if executed. Unused.

0x036.name: SetSprite
0x036.semantics: B66270: semi-trans bits in +0xCC, frame-script pointers +0xD0/+0xD4/+0xD8 and descriptor +0xE4 from the sprite table (param0 bit15 selects group/frame form), sets draw handler 5 (B65320 also appends the bone to the draw order list); orientation +0x1E = 1.

0x037.name: ResetAccum
0x037.semantics: Zero accumRot/accumPos (+0x50..+0x67), run the bone handler, outAngle = HIWORD(accumRot).

0x038.name: SetTargetModelColor
0x038.semantics: RGB = clamp(base colour bytes at CURRENT_BS_MODEL_PALETTE + src - 128) packed, stored at (*(sceneHeader+0x60+4*bone[0x1B]))+0x28: tints the battle model of the target slot.

0x03A.name: NullNoAdvance
0x03A.semantics: nullsub: no advance, no wait (hang if executed). Unused.

0x03C.name: SetMeshScaled
0x03C.semantics: B2F380: clear semi-trans, +0xBC=0, mesh ptr +0xD8 = B657E0(meshId), draw handler 1 registered; then drawHandlerId=2 (mesh with outAngle*16 XYZ scale).

0x03D.name: SetMeshTexParam
0x03D.semantics: colour(+0xCC)=0x808080 keeping bit25; meshPtr(+0xD8)=MagResource(w1); +0xB8=16*w2; +0xBC=0; SetDrawHandler(w0 & 0xFF) (also adds the bone to the draw order list).
0x03D.notes: MagResource = sub_B657E0 (b00 resource table via ctx+0xAC).

0x03E.name: SetInlineDescriptor3
0x03E.semantics: bone+0xBC = pointer to the 3 inline words following the opcode (&w0); data read by the draw handler.

0x03F.name: CreateEmbeddedModel
0x03F.semantics: Allocates (bump arena, 0x80 bytes) an embedded battle-model instance from mag resource w0 (skeleton/anim/geometry, BattleAnimHeader+Cmd, pre_Battle_ReadAnimation), stores it at bone+0xBC and selects draw handler 3 (the creature).

0x040.name: ColourFromBoneOutPos
0x040.semantics: bone colour(+0xCC) RGB = clamp(0..255) of srcBone outPos X/Y/Z, top byte kept.

0x041.name: EmbeddedModelFlags
0x041.high_bits: op>>12 sub-op: 0 = clear bits w0 in instance word +2; 1 = set flag 0x400 in instance word +2 and instance+0x7C = &w0 (2 inline words); 8 = set bits w0; any other sub-op does NOT advance the cursor (hang, never used).
0x041.semantics: Flag/override operations on the embedded model instance at bone+0xBC (created by 0x3F).
0x041.notes: Meaning of sub-op 1 inline data unknown (read by draw handler 3).

0x042.name: EntityAnimSeq

operands.name: seqIndex_or_target
operands.type: s16 (sub 0: battle-entity AnimSeq index; sub 2: rel16)

0x042.high_bits: op>>9 = sub-op: 0 = start anim seq; 2 = test anim finished. Any other value returns without advancing the cursor (would hang; unused).
0x042.semantics: Entity = SceneHeader entity ptr [bone+0x1B] (bone's battle-entity slot, SceneHeader+0x60+4*slot). Sub 0: QueueChainTransformation(entity, p0) = start that entity's section-5 AnimSeq p0 (multi-part chain aware; bit 0x1000 forces). Sub 2: if entity.anim_cmd.current_frame (+0x72) == total_frames (+0x73) jump rel p0.
0x042.notes: Handlers identical. Validated: Bahamut '0042 0004 5005', '0042 0004 0002'; Brothers '0042 0004 5005 0020'; Bahamut sub 2 '0442 0074 0001'.

0x043.name: SetDrawHandlerInlineData
0x043.semantics: SetDrawHandler(w0); bone+0xB8 = pointer to the inline block of w1 words; bone+0xBC=0; cursor skips the block.
0x043.notes: Verified in MAG200_B.00: 0043 0015 0003 xxxx xxxx xxxx -> draw handler 21 (texture scroll) with 3 inline words, next word is a valid opcode.

0x044.name: SetDrawHandlerInlineDataReset
0x044.semantics: As 0x43 and also clears bone+0xC0 and bone+0xC4 (handler frame/timer state).

0x045.name: EntityFlagBits
0x045.high_bits: op>>12: 0 = set bits w0; 1 = clear bits only if (sceneHeader+0x4E[slot] & w0)==0; 8 = clear bits; others = no-op.
0x045.semantics: Sets/clears bits in the first u16 (entity_flags/status_flags) of the FF8BattleEntitySlotData of bone->slotId (sceneHeader+0x60 table).

0x046.name: JumpIfTargetResult
0x046.high_bits: op>>9 condition on the target record (ctx+0xCC list, 24-byte entries, entry[0]==bone slot): 1 = jump if entry[3]&4; 2 = jump if entry[2]&8; 3 = jump if entry[3]&2; 4 = jump if BATTLE_SLOT_DATA[slot].status_2 & 0x2000; other (0,5..127) = jump if !(entry[3]&4).
0x046.semantics: Conditional jump to opcode address + w0 on the action-result state of the bone's target slot; else falls through (4 bytes).

0x048.name: OverrideEntityTransform
0x048.high_bits: (op>>9)&0xF: 0 = entity based_position(+0x1C..+0x20) = outPos, and if bit15 also entity+0x24 = outPosY; 1 = entity based_rotation(+0x0C..+0x10) = outAngle; others = flag only. Always entity status_flags |= 0x10.
0x048.semantics: Drives the battle entity of bone->slotId from the bone outputs.

0x049.name: JumpIfEntitySize
0x049.high_bits: op & 0xFE00 != 0: fall through if entity+0x26 >= w0 else jump; == 0: fall through if entity+0x26 <= w0 else jump.
0x049.semantics: Compares entity+0x26 (s16; IDB name animation_speed_factor, used as size/radius by 0x60/0x75) with w0, jumps to opcode address + w1.

0x04B.name: TintPaletteUpload
0x04B.high_bits: op>>12: 0 = 256 colours, delta from own outAngle; 1 = w2 colours, delta from bone w3 outAngle; 2 = w2 colours, own outAngle.
0x04B.semantics: Copies CLUT resource (w0&0xFF) from colour w1, adds a 5-bit RGB delta (outAngle X/Y/Z, <32) to each 15-bit colour into bank 0x279822C+512*(w0>>8), uploads it as alternate texture palette.

0x04E.name: SetDescriptorInlineData
0x04E.semantics: *(u32*)(bone+0xB8+4*w0) = pointer to inline block of w1 words; cursor skips the block.

0x050.name: FreeArenaBlock
0x050.semantics: Arena top (ctx+0x74) -= bone+0xC4 bytes (4-aligned): releases the bone's pool.

0x052.name: SetTexture
0x052.semantics: w0 == -1: clear tpage(+0x92), uv(+0x9A), clut(+0x9E); else set them from texture resource w0 (tpage keeps bits 0x60).

0x053.name: MusicVolume
0x053.high_bits: bit15: 1 = Music_SetVolumeTrans(channel 0); 0 = sub_47E3C0 (credits/intro channel, skipped if ENCOUTER_BATTLE_FLAG&2)
0x053.semantics: Sets music volume w0 (low byte), no transition.

0x055.name: JumpIfSummonState
0x055.high_bits: op>>9: 1 = jump if ctx+0xD0 != ctx+0xD1; 2 = jump if (rec.byte1 & 3)==1; 3 = jump if rec.byte1 & 2; other = jump if ctx+0xD0 != 0 (rec = *(ctx+0xC0)).
0x055.semantics: Conditional jump to opcode address + w0 on summon-wide state.

0x056.name: SetClippedMesh
0x056.semantics: As 0x54, then draw handler 9 (Y-plane clipped mesh) and +0xC2 = w1.

0x058.name: CreateParticlePool
0x058.semantics: Allocates 80*w0+16 bytes (arena) as particle pool at +0xB8, clears it, SetDrawHandler(6).

0x059.name: EmitParticle
0x059.high_bits: bit12 = emit into the pool of bone w0 (else own pool).
0x059.semantics: Takes next ring slot of the pool, starts its particle mini-script at (bit12: address of w0 + w1; else opcode address + w0); particle pos = current bone outPos<<8, tpage/uv/colour from pool bone.
0x059.notes: Bug: with bit12, if w0 resolves to no bone (bones[0]) the cursor advances only 4 bytes. Verified: runs like 0059 0016 0059 0012 0059 000e 0059 000a 0209 0002 ffee all point to the same particle script; 0x02 then loops back.

0x05B.name: AttachToModelJoint
0x05B.high_bits: bit10 = use the battle entity of bone->slotId (w0 ignored); bit11 = explicit joint w1 & scale 16*w2 (else joint = own outAngleX, scale 4096, matrix scaled by modelBone outAngle*16); op>>12: 0 = accumPos = joint pos + run bone handler; 1 = own node = Cam x joint matrix; 2 = write joint matrix to bone+0x20+(w1>>8) (if nonzero) or own node.
0x05B.semantics: Attaches the bone to a joint of an embedded or battle model (BattleModel_BuildBoneMatricesFromPose + sub_B66B80).
0x05B.notes: Skips if modelBone has no model (+0xBC==0).

0x05C.name: SnapToBoneVertex
0x05C.high_bits: bit15 (curOpcode < 0) selects mode: clear = morph-lerp vertex path (3 words); set = model-vertex transform path (4 words). Other bits ignored.
0x05C.semantics: Sets the CURRENT bone's accumPos (<<16) to the position of vertex vertexIndex of another bone's model, then calls the current bone's BoneHandlerTable[handlerId]. bit15 clear: vertex = lerp(modelA.v, modelB.v, weightBone.outPos/256 per axis) from morph descriptor *(target+0xBC) = {weightBone, modelA, modelB}, scaled by target.outAngle (16*x/4096), + parent(target).outPos. bit15 set: matrix from parent(target).outAngle + matrixParam (sub_B65590), scaled by target.outAngle, transform target.outPos and vertex of target's model (*(target+0xD8)).
0x05C.notes: All three are byte-identical clones. Validated: Brothers '805c 13ba 006c 0001 0209' x19 (8 B), Leviathan '005c 1dc4 0045 1c10' (6 B), Eden '805c 1676 0000 0000 0116'. Saves/restores g_GfCinematic_CurBonePtr via workspace+0x60.

0x05D.name: SpawnPerTarget
0x05D.semantics: For each target (count sceneHeader+0x41, slots at sceneHeader+0x48+i) spawns a clone bone via op 0x32's routine (0xB2D610) running program at opcode address + w0, and sets the clone's slotId(+0x1B).

0x05E.name: PosFromSlotHome
0x05E.semantics: accumPos = s16 xyz at sceneHeader+0x84+8*slot <<16; runs bone handler, refreshes outAngle.

0x05F.name: PosFromEntityOffset
0x05F.semantics: accumPos = entity based_position + w (component skipped if w == 0x7654); boneHandlerId=1, runs handler 1.

0x060.name: PosFromEntityJoint
0x060.semantics: accumPos = world position of joint w0 of the slot entity (+ orbit offset); runs bone handler.

0x061.name: CopyAccumFromBone
0x061.high_bits: shared with 0x62: only op word == 0x0061 exactly copies accumulators; any other word copies velocities
0x061.semantics: For mask bits 0..5 (rotXYZ,posXYZ) copies srcBone accumRot/accumPos; refreshes outAngle, runs bone handler.

0x063.name: PosFromBoneViaParent
0x063.semantics: Transforms srcBone outPos by its parent bone's (parentNodeId as bone ref) rotation (order w1: 0,1,2,3) + outPos; result to own accumPos; runs bone handler.

0x064.name: SetBoneSlot
0x064.high_bits: bit15 = slot of *(ctx+0xC0) (caster/primary); else bit12 = slot w0; else sceneHeader+0x48 (first target).
0x064.semantics: Sets bone->slotId(+0x1B), the battle slot used by every entity opcode.

0x065.name: NodeCamRotFromPos
0x065.semantics: Node = Cam x Rot(outPos as angles), translation = camera translation.

0x066.name: NodeCamTranslate
0x066.semantics: Node = camera rotation, translation = Cam x outPos, projection = ctx+2.

0x067.name: NodeCamRotTranslate
0x067.semantics: Node = Cam x Rot(outAngle), translation = Cam x outPos.

0x068.name: SetParentNode
0x068.semantics: parentNodeId(+0x9C) = w0 (param0, wiki says param1: wrong).
0x068.notes: Data uses w0 = 0xFFFF/0xFFFE/0xFFFD (bone-ref style special ids, resolved later by GetParentMatrix).

0x069.name: NodeChildOfParent
0x069.semantics: Node = Rot(outAngle) x Cam x parent node (w1), translation = outPos.

0x06A.name: NodeCamRotLocalPos
0x06A.semantics: Node = Cam x Rot(outAngle), translation = raw outPos, projection = ctx+2.

0x06B.name: SetFlagCA
0x06B.semantics: bone+0xCA |= 0x8000 (sprite frame-set mode flag, see sprite setup sub_B66270).

0x06D.name: PartyRecordFlag
0x06D.semantics: Sets/clears bit1 of byte +5 in 4 records of 44 bytes at 0x1D9898C.

0x06E.name: PosFromTargetsJointAvg
0x06E.semantics: accumPos components = average position of joint w0 over all targets; runs bone handler.
0x06E.notes: Divides by target count (div by zero if none).

0x070.name: Unused70
0x070.semantics: nullsub, does not advance (would hang); never valid.

0x071.name: DrawEntityInCinematic
0x071.high_bits: bit15: 1 = clear entity_flags 0x20; 0 = set it and draw the entity now
0x071.semantics: entity_flags |= 0x20 on the slot entity and renders its battle model into the cinematic render list (sub_5088A0); bit15 undoes the flag.

0x072.name: RotFromEntity
0x072.semantics: accumRot = slot entity based_rotation(+0x0C) <<16; refreshes outAngle.

0x073.name: SetSpriteOrient2
0x073.semantics: Sprite setup (sub_B2DA00: sprite res w0, draw handler 5, orientation 1), then orientation(+0x1E)=2 and bone+0xB8 = w1 (s16).

0x074.name: DrawFlagBits
0x074.semantics: drawFlags(+0x4C) |= w0; with bit15 code does flags &= ~w0 then flags |= ~w0 => flags = ~w0.

0x075.name: AccumFromEntitySize
0x075.high_bits: bits15..10 = mask rotX,rotY,rotZ,posX,posY,posZ; bit9 = size = max(entity+0x26, joint0 height extents)
0x075.semantics: Selected accumulators = (entitySize * w0) << 8; runs bone handler, refreshes outAngle.

0x076.name: AccumAddRandom
0x076.semantics: Per masked component accum += rand(range)<<16, range = rangeBone outAngle (rot) / outPos (pos); runs bone handler.

0x078.name: SetTexPage
0x078.semantics: bone+0x9A (tpage/uv base) = sceneHdr[+0x1C] + (page & 0xF) + 4*(page & 0x1F0) (X page bits 0-3, Y page bits 4-8 moved to the PSX tpage layout).

0x079.name: CompareFieldJump
0x079.high_bits: bits 12-14 = field index f: tested value = hi16 of dword at bone+0x50+4*f (0-2 accumRot XYZ, 3-5 accumPos XYZ, 6-7 velRot X/Y); bit 15 = comparison direction
0x079.semantics: bit15=0: if field < value fall through (+6) else jump; bit15=1: if field > value fall through else jump. Jump = cursor += target (relative to the opcode word). Used to loop until an accumulator crosses a value.

0x07A.name: NodeFromParentAndMatrix
0x07A.high_bits: bit 15: node projection value (matrix +0x12) = word ctx+0x02, else 0
0x07A.semantics: Node builder: own node slot (sub_B65480, keyed by bone id) = ComposeAffineTransform(parentNode, M) where parentNode = node of parentBone (camera node 0 if parentBone==0) and M = 3x3 matrix at curBone+matrixOffset (or the own node's current matrix if 0).
0x07A.notes: NOT in the wiki's node-builder list (0x65/66/67/69/6A/CB): it is a node builder too and must be logged/replayed by the 30fps held-frame rework if a script uses it.

0x07B.name: WaitThenReloadA8defTim
0x07B.semantics: If byte_2798218 (a8def.tim loader-idle flag) != 0: queue a load_aA8defTim task (sub_508630(dword ctx+0xB8, &flag); clears the flag) and continue (+2). Else vmWaitRequest = bone->chanWaitSpeed without advancing: the same instruction re-executes next tick (wait-until).
0x07B.notes: Yields only while the flag is 0.

0x07C.name: RandomOffsetXZ
0x07C.semantics: a=rand(4096); accumPosZ += 16*(radiusZBase+rand(radiusZRand))*cos(a); accumPosX += 16*(radiusXBase+rand(radiusXRand))*sin(a) (random point on an ellipse in the XZ plane). Consumes rand().

0x07D.name: SetBoneCount
0x07D.semantics: If count > sceneHdr[+0x38] (bones in use): clears chanStreamPtr[0] of bones [old..count) and sets sceneHdr[+0x38]=count (grow only).

0x081.name: SetSpriteAnimOriented
0x081.high_bits: bits 12-15 = sprite orientation type written to bone+0x1E
0x081.semantics: Same as op 0x80 (sub_B2DA00 -> sub_B66270(frameScript): sprite frame script at bone+0xD0.., colour code 0x2C, draw handler 5; frameScript bit15 = bank (p>>8)&0x7F + index p&0xFF), then bone+0x1E (orientation) = op>>12.

0x082.name: VelocityTowardBone
0x082.semantics: velPos XYZ = (target.accumPos - cur.accumPos)/frames (linear move onto another bone's position in N ticks).

0x083.name: ColorFromOutAngle
0x083.semantics: bone+0xCC colour RGB (low 24 bits) = clamp(outAngle X/Y/Z, 0, 255); top byte (GPU code / semi-trans) kept.

0x084.name: CopyMatrix
0x084.semantics: Copies a 32-byte matrix (3x3 + proj + translation) from srcBone+srcOffset (srcBone's node slot if 0) to curBone+dstOffset (cur's node slot if 0) via sub_B656A0.
0x084.notes: Writes node slots: relevant for the 30fps node-opcode replay.

0x087.name: VelocityScaleAccum
0x087.high_bits: bits 15..10 = component mask (bit15 velRotX .. bit10 velPosZ)
0x087.semantics: For each masked component: vel = ((accum>>16)*(scale256-256)<<8)/frames, so after `frames` ticks accum = accum*scale256/256 (scale toward/away from the origin).

0x089.name: StepEmbeddedModelAnim
0x089.semantics: sub_B269B0(bone+0xBC model block): SetupParentXformScaled, clear bit1 of block+2, GF_201Ifrit_StepEmbeddedModelAnim (advance creature keyframes), set bit1 again.
0x089.notes: Advances the handler-3 creature animation from the VM (animation phase), not only in the draw pass.

0x08A.name: BattleScreenFx
0x08A.length: 6 if (op >> 12) not in (1, 2, 3) else (4 if (op >> 12) in (1, 2) else 2)
0x08A.semantics: sub-op 1: sub_501F30(value) (retarget the existing battle fx task dword_1D96EBC: +0xE=value); 2: sub_501E40(value) (create that fx task if none, param=value); 3: sub_4A8480(0) (battle state: set bit 2 at +943, clear 0x100 at +942), no operand; other: byte +0xB = value+1 and byte +9 = value2 of the struct pointed by ctx+0xC0 (action/command context).

0x08B.name: StartChannel
0x08B.semantics: Starts a script on the SAME bone: channel = channel (1-3) or, if 0, first free of chanStreamPtr[1..3] (none free -> no-op). chanStreamPtr[ch] = (opcodeAddr + target) & 0x7FFFFFFF (positive = runs in the Pos phase); chanWait[ch]=0 and per-channel byte bone+0x44+ch = 0 (sub_B2D8A0). Current stream continues.

0x08D.name: ModelFlagsSetClear
0x08D.high_bits: bit 15: 0 = OR bits, 1 = AND NOT bits
0x08D.semantics: Object entry = dword sceneHdr[0x60 + 4*byte bone+0x1B]; its dword +0x7C |= bits (or &= ~bits).

0x08E.name: RemoveFromDrawList
0x08E.semantics: Removes the current bone id from g_GfCinematic_DrawOrderList (MAG_006_sub_B65270).

0x090.name: Nop10
0x090.semantics: No-op that just skips 10 bytes (stub in the Ifrit copy; probably a real opcode in another GF of the family).

0x091.name: AccumFromBoneOutputs
0x091.semantics: For mask bits 0..5 (LOW bit first: rotX,rotY,rotZ,posX,posY,posZ): cur.accum[i] = src.out[i]<<16 (outAngle XYZ / outPos XYZ); then recompute outAngle (B2C440) and run BoneHandlerTable[handlerId] (snap to another bone's pose).

0x092.name: SetField92And9A
0x092.semantics: bone+0x92 (word after outAngleZ) = value92, bone+0x9A (tpage/uv base) = value9A.

0x093.name: BuildLightMatrices
0x093.semantics: Builds a light set in BoneMatrixTable[slot]: +0 light-direction matrix = M(cols = 16*outPos of bones A/B/C, zero when -1) * Rot(16*lowbyte(cur.outPos)); +0x20 light-colour matrix (16*outAngle of A/B/C); +0x40 back colour = 16*cur.outAngle. Used when drawing bones with matrixSlotId != 0.
0x093.notes: Identical clones. Validated in MAG200 and MAG005: '0093 000N 0cXX ffff ffff 0209' x4, Leviathan '0093 0001 0c1c 0c1d ffff 0209'.

0x094.name: Unused
0x094.semantics: Handler is an empty nullsub: it neither advances g_GfCinematic_StreamCursor nor sets vmWaitRequest, so executing it would loop forever in the dispatcher. Opcode unused by Ifrit.
0x094.notes: Real consumed length is 0 (infinite loop); '2' is only a nominal value for disassemblers.

0x095.name: Nop4
0x095.semantics: No-op that just skips 4 bytes (stub in the Ifrit copy; probably a real opcode in another GF of the family).

0x096.name: CaptureScreenToVram
0x096.semantics: workspace.altTexParamA = vramX, workspace+0xF4 = vramY, then inserts into the render list a MoveImage of the current display buffer (5 strips of 64 px = 320 wide) to VRAM (vramX, vramY): screen grab for later distortion effects. Cerberus sub 0xB0EB60 (renamed GF_203Cerberus_QueueScreenCaptureMoveImage) = Eden GF_206Eden_Draw26_QueueScreenCaptureMoveImage 0xAEA2F0.
0x096.notes: Validated: Cerberus '0096 0240 0100 0209'. No unambiguous occurrence found in Eden's script region (only in its other programs, or not used).

0x09A.name: Unused
0x09A.semantics: Handler is an empty nullsub: it neither advances g_GfCinematic_StreamCursor nor sets vmWaitRequest, so executing it would loop forever in the dispatcher. Opcode unused by Ifrit.
0x09A.notes: Real consumed length is 0 (infinite loop); '2' is only a nominal value for disassemblers.

0x09B.name: ClearOptionBits
0x09B.high_bits: bits 9-15 = bits to clear in bone+0xDE

0x09C.name: SpawnBoneChained
0x09C.semantics: Same as op 0x32 (sub_B2D610): if the bone order list has room, take the first bone with chanStreamPtr[0]==0, append it to the bone order list and draw list, its chanStreamPtr[0] = opcodeAddr+target, clone accumPos/accumRot, handlerId, renderListOffset, +0x1B, +0xB0..0xB7, owner (+0x14/+0x16 = cur +0x12/+0x14), id = sceneHdr[0]++; run its bone handler; ws->parentMatrixPtr = new bone. 0x9C then overwrites new+0x14/+0x16 with id/+0x14 of the PREVIOUS bone in the array (chain).
0x09C.notes: If the list is full, ws->parentMatrixPtr = stale ecx and 0x9C writes through it (latent bug). Spawned stream pointer is not masked (sign of the absolute address decides the Neg/Pos phase).

0x09D.name: RecenterModelOffsetBone
0x09D.semantics: Computes the bounding-box centre c of model modelId's vertices (count at model+0x18, verts at model+*(model+0x14), 8-byte stride); cur.accumPos += (c*scale/256)<<16 per axis; calls the current bone handler; then subtracts c from every vertex (mesh re-centred IN PLACE, so later calls see c ~ 0).

0x09E.name: JumpIfCtxFlag15Clear
0x09E.semantics: If (ctx->flags & 0x8000)==0 jump cursor += target, else continue (+4).

0x09F.name: JumpIfCtxFlag15Set
0x09F.semantics: If (ctx->flags & 0x8000)!=0 jump cursor += target, else continue (+4). Decoded from raw bytes (no IDA function there).
0x09F.notes: IDA refused create_function at 0xB2FFF0; not renamed.

0x0A0.name: JumpIfCtxFlag13Clear
0x0A0.semantics: If (ctx->flags & 0x2000)==0 jump cursor += target, else continue (+4).
